hypothesis: Reprogramming of somatic cells to a pluripotent state can be achieved through transcription factor manipulation
prediction: Introduction of the four known stem cell regulatory factors (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc) into somatic cells will induce pluripotency
measurement_method: Flow cytometry or immunofluorescence for detection of pluripotency markers (e.g., SSEA-1, SSEA-4, TRA-1-60, TRA-1-81)
falsification_condition: If less than 1% of treated somatic cells express pluripotency markers, or if the introduced factors fail to induce the expression of endogenous pluripotency genes
